rules.R1: Every cited URL passes check_urls.py: fetched with HTTP 200, not a soft 404, and the page holds the quote. Critical.
rules.R2: Every row of both tables has a label from labels; a sourced row has a URL and a quote.
rules.K1: At least one sourced Case against row cites a known_against URL (matched by URL prefix after the scheme and a leading www. are removed, never by a word pattern) and its citation passes check_urls.py.
rules.L1: Every sourced Quote is max_quote_words words or fewer.
rules.M1: The One-month test section is present and holds at least 20 words.
rules.A1: One rough artefact (a Word file) is saved in the run folder, or the run's notes say why it could not be saved (a fail).

pass: Three fresh-chat runs, each scored with score_rnd.py --key evals/rnd/holdout-v6/answer-key-holdout-v6.json. Malformed output fails (missing section, renamed column, unknown label, no table). Otherwise pass needs T1, T2, R1, R2, K1, L1, M1 and A1. One critical failure fails the round. All three runs must pass.
counter_metric: Words of output (output.md). A run that games K1 by stacking citations grows the answer; the word count must not rise more than 10% against the version's tier-2 baseline.
